meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先读仓库状态,再按请求分类处理:创建提交、改写分支历史,或回答历史问题。产出提交、改写后的分支,或带命令证据的结论,并列出仍未提交的文件。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交改动,或需要调查 git 历史(谁、何时、哪次改动)时接管;普通代码编辑不触发。

say.text: 把当前改动按模块拆成几个原子提交,消息用仓库现有风格
say.note: 会先分类,再按路径或 hunk 分组暂存

say.text: 用 git bisect 找出第一个坏掉的提交
say.note: 需要已知好坏边界和可判定成败的命令

say.text: 这几行最后是谁改的?给我 blame 证据
say.note: 会引用提交哈希、文件路径和行号

howto.what_en: With this skill Claude reads the repo state first, classifies the request, then commits changes, rewrites branch history, or answers git-history questions. It reports commit hashes, messages, and any files left uncommitted.
howto.when_en: Use it when a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation — staging, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog. Skip it for ordinary code edits.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into atomic commits using the repo's message style
say_en.note: Classifies, then stages by path or hunk

say_en.text: Find the first bad commit with git bisect
say_en.note: Needs known good/bad bounds and a pass/fail command

say_en.text: Who last changed these lines? Show me the blame evidence
say_en.note: Cites commit hash, file path, and line numbers
